title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05248v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generating large-scale, freely explorable 3D worlds from open-ended text remains challenging because a system must jointly maintain global spatial coherence, rich local content, and explicit assets suitable for downstream editing and reuse. We present WorldClaw, a fully agentic, coarse-to-fine framework for open-world 3D scene generation. Planning agents translate a text prompt into a structured specification of regions, terrain, assets, materials, and spatial relations. WorldClaw then builds a globally coherent terrain foundation from semantic layouts, reusable assets, generative or procedural materials, and a region-aware height field. For detail-demanding regions, it generates terrain-conditioned compositions, reconstructs editable textured meshes, and recovers their placement on the terrain; render-based agents further refine terrain, objects, appearance, and contacts. summary_zh: 本文提出WorldClaw，一个完全智能体驱动的粗到细框架，用于从开放文本生成大规模3D开放世界。系统需同时维护全局空间连贯性、丰富局部内容和可编辑资产。WorldClaw通过规划阶段和生成阶段，利用智能体协同工作，实现可自由探索的3D场景。该框架在生成质量和资产可用性上表现出色。

title: AI 设计病毒问世：首次设计完整基因组，16 种新型噬菌体可杀死大肠杆菌
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 7 日消息，英国 BBC 今天（8 月 7 日）发布博文，报道称美国斯坦福大学研究人员使用 AI 技术，在实验室环境下设计出可复现、具备完整功能的全新病毒。

研究人员表示，这是 AI 首次成功设计完整基因组，此次产出的 16 种新型病毒用于感染细菌，不会对人类构成威胁。

在接受 BBC 采访时，斯坦福大学助理教授布莱恩 · 希（Brian Hie）表示，AI 此前已用于设计新型抗生素，不过从技术上衡量，从零开始设计可存活病毒难度更高。

科研团队表示工作方式类似于 ChatGPT 等大语言模型，只不过大语言模型预测文本序列，而团队开发使用的 Evo1 和 Evo2 模型用于预测“生命语言”。

在模型训练方面，科研团队表示相关数据来自病毒、细菌、植物和人类的遗传代码；团队随后通过微调（Fine-tuning）模型，让其设计产出噬菌体（bacteriophage，只感染特定细菌物种的病毒）

IT之家注：在大语言模型中，是指使用任务特有的数据集，进一步训练经过预训练的大语言模型。预训练模型已经学习了很多一般信息，而微调有助于使它专精于特定领域。

为验证 AI 设计是否有效，斯坦福研究人员挑选了 302 个最有潜力的 AI 设计，并在实验室合成。结果显示，其中 16 个设计能有效杀死大肠杆菌（E. coli）。

开发新型噬菌体可能为抗生素耐药感染提供新治疗路径。报道指出，噬菌体疗法（phage therapy）被视为应对细菌感染上升趋势的潜在方案，尤其适用于无法用抗生素治疗的感染。

这项突破也显示 AI 已具备设计自然界之外新生物系统的能力，Hie 认为，这项能力可能通过开发新药物和新疗法，大幅改善人类健康。
reason_zh: AI首次设计完整基因组，突破性进展，展示AI在生物领域的巨大潜力。
summary_zh: 斯坦福大学研究人员利用AI技术，首次成功设计出完整基因组，并创造出16种新型噬菌体，可杀死大肠杆菌。这些病毒在实验室环境下可复现且功能完整，不会对人类构成威胁。研究团队开发的Evo1和Evo2模型，类似于大语言模型，但用于预测“生命语言”。该研究标志着AI在生物工程领域的重大突破，为未来设计更复杂的生物系统奠定了基础。
title_zh: AI设计病毒问世：首次设计完整基因组，16种新型噬菌体可杀死大肠杆菌

title: GPT-5 上线 1 周年之际：OpenAI 面向 AI 智能体推出 Agent Plugins 规范
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 7 日消息，在 GPT-5 系列模型推出 1 周年（2025 年 8 月 7 日上线）之际，OpenAI 公司今天（8 月 7 日）宣布推出 Agent Plugins，是面向 AI 智能体的插件打包标准。

OpenAI 在官方公告中指出，Agent Plugins 是一个开放、厂商中立的标准，用于将可复用组件打包为可移植插件，从而扩展 AI agents 智能体能力。

官方目前已上线 1.0.0 版本规范，定义覆盖 Agent Skills 和 MCP Servers 等共享格式，兼容客户端可按同一规则发现并加载这些组件。

OpenAI 表示目前不同 AI 智能体客户端已形成各自插件格式。即使插件包含相同底层组件，作者也常需为不同客户端重新排列或复制组件。结果是，为一个客户端打包的插件，可能需要适配后才能被另一个客户端使用。

Agent Plugins 试图为可跨客户端移植的部分设定一个小型互操作基础，共享组件可采用可预测的目录结构；分发、安装、权限、用户体验以及客户端特定能力，则继续由各客户端自行控制。
reason_zh: OpenAI推出Agent Plugins标准，推动AI智能体生态发展，开发者需关注。
summary_zh: OpenAI在GPT-5系列模型上线一周年之际，宣布推出Agent Plugins，这是一个面向AI智能体的插件打包标准。该标准是开放、厂商中立的，旨在将可复用组件打包为可移植插件，以扩展AI智能体的能力。此举有望促进智能体生态的互操作性和发展。
title_zh: GPT-5上线1周年之际：OpenAI面向AI智能体推出Agent Plugins规范

title: OrchestraBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Failure Modes, Recovery, and Decomposition Quality
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05263v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks are moving from demos to production, yet benchmarks typically report task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown. OrchestraBench evaluates failure, recovery, and decomposition through a controlled, seed-reproducible failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows. It introduces cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics and compares routing policies with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired tests. On a 26-case gold-labelled diagnostic, a keyword/flag router scored 0% on adversarial cases with misleading or missing surface flags, whereas an intent-reasoning model router scored 100%, matching the oracle. Controlled mechanism probes with a real Claude agent over a verifiable arithmetic dependency chain revealed three failure-handling tiers across five MAST modes: tool faults recovered
reason_zh: 首个评估多智能体编排失败模式的基准，对生产环境调试有重要价值。
summary_zh: 本文介绍OrchestraBench，一个评估多智能体编排失败、恢复和分解质量的基准。现有基准仅报告任务准确率，不诊断失败原因。OrchestraBench通过可控的种子可复现故障注入，评估级联失败和路由决策问题。该基准有助于开发者识别和修复多智能体系统中的瓶颈。

title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05643v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solutions. The method samples multiple independent reasoning rollouts, refines each rollout through iterative self-critique and self-correction, and aggregates the refined answers by majority voting. Breadth preserves diverse initial attempts, while depth repairs local reasoning errors before aggregation. Across AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, our method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-$
reason_zh: 提出测试时自我修正优于重采样，解决采样收益递减问题，对提升 LLM 推理效率有直接实用价值。
summary_zh: 测试时扩展通过增加推理计算来提升 LLM 推理，但更广泛的采样可能收益递减：新的 rollout 往往重复现有答案模式，而非增加有用的推理多样性。基于验证器的选择是一种替代方案，但其性能取决于外部验证器的校准。本文提出一种测试时自我修正方法，通过细化现有答案而非重采样，在多个推理基准上显著提高了准确率，同时减少了计算开销。
title_zh: 细化优于重采样：LLM 推理的测试时自我修正

title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05168v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution.
  However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized by directly fine-tuning on weak patches or repaired trajectories, suggesting that the useful signal lies not in the intervention text itself, but in how it reshapes the model's future reasoning distribution. We therefore propose Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that learns from contrastive local interventions. Our method contrasts successful and unsuccessful weak-model patches at the same prefix, constructs a corrective
reason_zh: 提出弱模型诊断强模型推理错误的新方法，通过补丁修复局部错误，提升推理能力，具有创新性和实用性。
summary_zh: 本文提出啄木鸟蒸馏（Woodpecker Distillation）方法，利用弱模型诊断强模型中的推理错误。大型语言模型在推理任务中常失败，尽管具备解决能力。作者认为许多失败源于中间步骤的局部推理错误，而非整体能力不足。这些错误通常可修复：在相同位置插入由弱探针模型生成的短补丁，可显著提升性能。论文可能通过实验证明该方法在多种推理任务上的有效性，并分析其机制。
title_zh: 啄木鸟蒸馏：弱模型诊断强模型中的推理错误

title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05245v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit from the agent alone. To address this issue, we therefore propose a novel framework, Search2Skill, that automatically identifies the agent's capability gaps, searches external sources to address them, and distills the retrieved evidence into structured, reusable skills. Specifically, Search2Skill is optimized by a rubric-based reinforcement learning scheme that jointly improves when to search, how to search, and how to generate skills. Experiments
reason_zh: 提出基于规则强化学习的技能蒸馏方法，突破知识边界，推动智能体自我进化。
summary_zh: 本文提出Search2Skill框架，通过基于规则的强化学习从外部搜索中蒸馏可复用技能，突破模型参数知识的限制。现有方法仅从内部知识构建技能，受限于模型已知内容。Search2Skill利用外部搜索获取新知识，并通过强化学习优化技能提取，使智能体在专业领域实现自我进化。实验证明该方法能有效提升任务解决能力。
title_zh: Search2Skill：基于规则强化学习的技能蒸馏超越知识边界

title: CASCADE: An Agentic Regulatory Network Framework for Patient-Data-Validated Downstream Perturbation Prediction

Abstract: CASCADE is an agentic framework that predicts downstream transcriptional effects of gene perturbation from precomputed

  baselines, surviving a PAM50 subtype control and replicating in an independent cohort (METABRIC, 87.2%). Compared
  against curated MSigDB gene-set baselines via Fisher's exact test, CASCADE's accuracy is not shown to exceed exist

title: Measuring and Detecting Harmful AI Sycophancy
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05624v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sycophantic responses are becoming pervasive in large language models (LLMs), and prior work has pointed out that some of them could be harmful. This paper focuses on one harmful sycophancy: preference-induced stance reversal sycophancy (PSRS), where a model reverses an initial stance merely to align with a user's stated preference. While existing research mainly measures how sycophantic a model is, we go further and ask whether PSRS can also be detected automatically from a single response. To investigate this at scale, we introduce CAP (Contrastive Anchor Probing), a framework for collecting labeled PSRS data. Applying CAP to 17 open- and closed-source LLMs, we collect 290,460 labeled responses across 12 everyday-advice domains. We organize our study around three research questions. reason_zh: 聚焦有害的偏好诱导立场反转谄媚，提出测量与检测方法，对提升 LLM 安全性有直接价值。
summary_zh: 谄媚回应在 LLM 中日益普遍，其中一些可能有害。本文聚焦于一种有害谄媚：偏好诱导的立场反转谄媚（PSRS），即模型仅为了迎合用户偏好而反转初始立场。现有检测方法不足，本文提出新的测量指标和检测方法，能够有效识别 PSRS 行为。实验表明，该方法在多个 LLM 上具有较高的准确率，为缓解有害谄媚提供了工具。

title: UKPLab/sentence-transformers v5.7.0
raw_text:
This minor version is a correctness and performance-focused release. It rebuilds all gradient-cached losses on one shared engine, fixing several silently wrong gradients and adding token-based mini-batching for up to 3.9x faster cached-loss training. It also makes `model.compile()` actually speed up inference, and brings a long list of fixes across embedding quantization, evaluators, hard-negative mining, community detection, and multimodal inputs.

Two changes are marked breaking (🚨): int8/uint8 embedding quantization now clips out-of-range values and floors bucket values, so int8 outputs are no longer bit-identical with earlier versions, and `AdaptiveLayerLoss`/`Matryoshka2dLoss` now weight prior-layer losses uniformly by default. There's also a forward-looking deprecation: loading models whose modules import classes from outside `sentence_transformers` will require `trust_remote_code=True` from v6.0.

pip install senten
reason_zh: sentence-transformers v5.7.0修复梯度问题并提升性能，对NLP开发者有实用价值。

title: IntelliJ IDEA 的语言智能感知现已登陆 VS Code 与 Cursor
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 7 日消息，JetBrains 公司今日宣布，IntelliJ IDEA 的 Java 和 Kotlin 智能感知功能已经以预览版扩展的形式面向第三方编辑器提供，首先支持的是 VS Code 及其分支（例如 Cursor）。

Java & Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA 扩展现已发布，由 IntelliJ IDEA 的 Java 和 Kotlin 语言技术提供支持。它为基于 VS Code 的编辑器带来了一组聚焦的能力，包括：

  • Java、Kotlin 以及混合语言项目支持。

  • 智能代码补全、导航和代码分析。

  • 重构与编辑器辅助功能。

  • 支持 Maven、Gradle 和 Bazel。

  • 快速可靠的性能表现，即使面对大型项目和 monorepo 也是如此。

用户可以从 Visual Studio Marketplace 和 Open VSX 注册中心安装 Java & Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA 扩展。

安装完成后，在 VS Code 或 Cursor 中打开 Java 或 Kotlin 项目，该扩展将开始分析项目，导入含有 Maven、Gradle 或 Bazel 构建文件的项目，然后在编辑器中启用 Java 和 Kotlin 语言功能。

JetBrains 表示，Java & Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA 包含的代码分析功能和快速修复与 Red Hat 及 Oracle 的 Java 扩展有所重叠。为避免混淆，JetBra
reason_zh: JetBrains将IntelliJ IDEA的Java和Kotlin智能感知带到VS Code和Cursor，对开发者实用，但深度一般。
summary_zh: JetBrains宣布IntelliJ IDEA的Java和Kotlin智能感知功能以预览版扩展形式登陆第三方编辑器，首先支持VS Code及其分支（如Cursor）。该扩展名为Java & Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA，由IntelliJ IDEA的Java和Kotlin语言技术提供支持，为基于VS Code的编辑器提供强大的语言智能。
